Your privacy

This website stores information on your device. Some of it is needed for the pages to work. The rest runs only if you agree. You choose what to allow, and you can change your mind at any time. Privacy policy

What you allow

Delivers the pages and remembers the choice you make here. No third party is involved and none of it identifies you.

Apollo.io, a service of ZenLeads Inc. in the United States, receives your IP address and the pages you open, and matches the address against its own database of company networks. It tells us which companies read our work, not which people. It sets no cookies, but it stores an identifier in your browser.

Get Started

Allplan MCP

Ask the model.

Talk to Allplan in your own words. It reads the model you have open, provides answers, highlights elements and adjusts attributes where necessary.

Panel 04

Attribute maintenance

The problem

  1. A panel can look finished in the viewport and still be missing the field production reads.
  2. Nothing is broken, so nothing warns you.
  3. At ten thousand elements, checking that by hand is not a task anyone finishes.

Four steps

How it works

  1. 01

    You ask in plain language.

  2. 02

    The assistant decides what to look up.

  3. 03

    Allplan MCP reads or writes in the open model.

  4. 04

    You see the answer and the elements it means, highlighted in the drawing.

AI assistant

Allplan MCP

Open model

Your workstation

The model stays on your workstation. Nothing is exported and no second copy is created.

Three examples

What you can ask

Which panels are missing a concrete grade?

Nine of thirty-six. Highlighted in the drawing.

Are all the concrete grades valid?

Two panels read C34/45, which is not a grade in EN 1992.

Which of these panels is the heaviest?

4.84 m³, about 12.1 t. The lightest panel with the same outside dimensions weighs 7.5 t.

What is in Lite

The six operations

  • Find elements

    Search by position number, layer, attribute value or element type.

  • Read attributes

    Every value held on an element.

  • Write attributes

    Set, change or clear values.

  • Read geometry

    Dimensions, volume, surface area, center of gravity.

  • Zoom to element

    Bring elements into view in every open window.

  • Highlight

    Mark elements in the drawing so the selection is visible.

Connection and session tools come with it. Check the connection, list what a session did and undo it.
